moodys.citation_text: Missouri State Health & Educ. Facs. Auth. -- Moody's assigns A1 to SSM Health, MO's Ser. 2022A; outlook stable. Subsequently revised to negative in 2024.

sp.citation_text: S&P rating for SSM Health at AA- coming into window; later affirmations in 2024 maintain AA- per joint criteria coverage.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch Assigns 'AA-' IDR to SSM Health, MO and Affirms Outstanding Bonds at 'AA-'; Outlook Negative — sourced from FreeLibrary 2018 entry; subsequently revised in 2024.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Moody's revised SSM Health (MO) outlook to negative from stable; A1 affirmed
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Operating performance falling short of expectations; one-time write-down related to revenue cycle; $123M operating loss in 2024
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Moody's revises SSM Health's (MO) outlook to negative; A1 affirmed (Moody's press release).

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Fitch affirmed AA- and revised outlook to negative from stable
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Operating performance fell short in fiscal 2024; one-time write-down accounted for most of $123 million operating loss in 2024; operational performance weak for several years
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Fitch affirmed SSM Health's rating at AA- with outlook revised to negative from stable; St. Louis-based system's operating performance fell short of expectations in fiscal 2024.

moodys.citation_text: A1 negative outlook per 2024 Moody's outlook revision.

sp.citation_text: S&P rating maintained at AA- through window; no S&P rating action in trade press.

outcome_class_rationale: Both Moody's and Fitch revised outlook to negative in 2024 while affirming ratings. No actual rating downgrades. Per schema, AFFIRM_NEGATIVE_OUTLOOK = outlook revised negative by ≥1 agency, no rating change.
